lines.zh: 闪烁着星辉的盔甲摩擦着走廊的石墙。
lines.en: Its armor clicks against the stone walls.

lines.zh: 手中星辰微光指引着前行的路。
lines.en: Stars in its hand guide its path.

lines.zh: 盔甲上的星盘反射着幽暗的光芒。
lines.en: The star disk on its armor glows darkly.

lines.zh: 脚步声在寂静的走廊中回荡。
lines.en: Its footsteps echo in the silent corridor.

lines.zh: 它的目光如星辰般闪烁不定。
lines.en: Its gaze flickers like stars.

lines.zh: 盔甲上的星辉若隐若现。
lines.en: Its armor's starlight flickers.

lines.zh: 它行走在古老的石质走廊中。
lines.en: It walks in the ancient stone corridor.

lines.zh: 星辰的光芒映照在它的眼眸里。
lines.en: Starlight shines in its eyes.
Its steps are firm and steady.

lines.zh: 星光与盔甲交织出神秘的图案。
lines.en: Stars and armor weave a mysterious pattern.

lines.zh: 停在走廊尽头等你回头
lines.en: I stop at the corridor's end and wait for you to look back.

lines.zh: 甲片擦过墓砖，火星四溅
lines.en: My plates scrape the crypt bricks and throw sparks.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，眼神望向远方。
lines.en: It stands still, gaze fixed on the distance.

lines.zh: 星盘在它的注视下显得格外明亮。
lines.en: The star disk shines brightly under its gaze.

lines.zh: 它偶尔轻声呢喃，仿佛在祷告。
lines.en: It mutters softly, as if in prayer.

lines.zh: 星辰在其周围缓缓旋转。
lines.en: Stars slowly rotate around it.

lines.zh: 它用目光扫视四周的黑暗。
lines.en: Its gaze sweeps the darkness around.

lines.zh: 星光闪烁，照亮了它周围的空间。
lines.en: Stars flicker, lighting up the space around it.

lines.zh: 拿着一千零二十四点伤害，等你路过。
lines.en: Carrying a thousand twenty-four damage, waiting for you to pass.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出一丝冷酷。
lines.en: Its gaze reveals a coldness.

lines.zh: 星辰在它身上散发出奇异的光芒。
lines.en: Stars emit an unusual light on it.

lines.zh: 它静静站立，等待着猎物出现。
lines.en: It stands quietly, waiting for its prey to appear.

lines.zh: 它突然警觉，目光锁定了玩家。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto the player suddenly.

lines.zh: 它察觉到了玩家的踪迹。
lines.en: It senses the player's presence.

lines.zh: 它向玩家的方向缓缓转头。
lines.en: It slowly turns its head towards the player.

lines.zh: 它的目光如利剑般穿透黑暗。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces the darkness like a sword.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着玩家，随时准备攻击。
lines.en: It stares at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的目光中充满了敌意。
lines.en: Its gaze is full of hostility.

lines.zh: 它的目光紧紧锁定在了玩家身上。
lines.en: Its gaze is fixed on the player.

lines.zh: 它向玩家发出警告的低语。
lines.en: It whispers a warning to the player.
Its gaze sparkles with menace.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你胸口，那儿最暖。
lines.en: My gaze settles on your chest, the warmest spot.

lines.zh: 星盘转了半圈，认出你了
lines.en: My dial turns half a circle and recognises you.
The Eyeflare in your hand is far too bright.
My gaze is colder than your torch.

lines.zh: 你的攻击如流星划破夜空！
lines.en: Your attack is a meteor in the night!
Your arrow pierced me!
My light is blocked by you!

lines.zh: 你的剑刃划破了我的星盘！
lines.en: Your sword cut my star dial!
I don't like your Eyeflare!
Your magic hurts me!

lines.zh: 你让我的队伍失去了方向！
lines.en: You've lost our way!

lines.zh: 你的斧头差点要了我的命！
lines.en: Your axe nearly killed me!

lines.zh: 我需要休息，你别打扰我！
lines.en: I need rest, don't disturb me!

lines.zh: 你的行为让我不再信任！
lines.en: Your actions make me distrust you!
Lure travelers with your glow!
Eyeflare holder, you die here.

lines.zh: 你手里那只眼睛我认得。
lines.en: That eye in your hand. I know it.
Gleam of hunger, lures you.
Follow me into darkness.
My light, dispels darkness.
Yours, cannot escape.
Eyeflare irresistible.
Your light is out.
Glow leads to death.
Collide with living, shatter will.
Collide, vanish.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲把你顶回走廊那头。
lines.en: My shoulder plate shoves you back down the corridor.
Collide, release power.
Shatter until destruction.
Power blooms in collision.
Collide, shatter all.
Your power is not enough.
Collide, shatter all obstacles.
I knock you aside and only echoes remain.
Star dial, witness our union.
Mate with me, eternal stars.
Stars guide, eternal union.
Stars bear witness, our union.
Dance with stars, never apart.
Stars eternal, union eternal.
Stars guide, our journey.
Stars bear witness, our love.
Under stars, our union.
Stars eternal, union enduring.
Found the target!
Eyeflare flickers, prey is here.

lines.zh: 星盘一转，食物就靠近了。
lines.en: The dial turns and food draws near.

lines.zh: 地上的血迹，我弯腰就能捡起。
lines.en: The blood on the floor, I can simply stoop and pick it up.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四，一击就够。
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four. One hit is enough.
The stars guide my actions.
Hunter of the Catacombs.

lines.zh: 我的目标不会轻易逃走。
lines.en: My target won't escape easily.
Prey is drawn by the stars.
Under the night sky, my sight is keen.

lines.zh: 墓道尽头的脚步，我听见了。
lines.en: Footsteps at the end of the tomb passage; I hear them.
Locked in!

lines.zh: 你手里的 Eyeflare 亮得像灯塔。
lines.en: That Eyeflare in your hand shines like a lighthouse.
Stars guide my attack.
Your doom is here.
My pointer swings to you, and I move.

lines.zh: 拿着 Eyeflare 的人，我都能找到。
lines.en: Anyone holding the Eyeflare, I will find.
Fate in the stars.
I have locked the doors at both ends.
Stars guide, prey revealed.
With that Eyeflare in hand, all you can do is run.

lines.zh: 星辰把我的路指给了你
lines.en: The stars have pointed my path at you.
Both ends of this corridor are mine.
One thousand and twenty-four heartbeats.
You stepped on a loose crypt tile.

lines.zh: 我追的，是你手里的眼焰。
lines.en: I hunt the Eyeflare in your hand.

lines.zh: 星盘转到你的方向，停住了。
lines.en: My star dial turns to your bearing and stops.

lines.zh: 这条走廊没有窗，也没有出口。
lines.en: This corridor has no windows and no way out.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，星光就亮一分。
lines.en: With every step I take, the starlight grows brighter.
The kiss of death in the stars.

lines.zh: 猎物，你将为我的力量付出代价。
lines.en: Prey, you'll pay for my strength.
Stars guide my every strike.

lines.zh: 星光下的猎物无处遁形。
lines.en: Prey has no where to hide in the stars.
The end in the stars.
The stars have worked out how you die.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲一件件亮起来
lines.en: My armor lights up, piece by piece.
The door behind you has shut.
My star chart surfaces on the walls.
You can only go forward, and forward is me.
I will move when I reach three.
Your breath scatters my stardust.
These crypt halls have no side paths.
Every tile I tread begins to glow.
Your shadow is pinned to the wall.
Look up. The dial hangs right above you.

lines.zh: 我的甲拳砸在你的盾上。
lines.en: My armored fist crashes down on your shield.
Eat you, taste this!

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我的毒液会要你的命！
lines.en: You can't escape, my venom will kill you!

lines.zh: 星辉凝在指节，落向你的肩。
lines.en: Starlight gathers on my knuckles and falls on your shoulder.
Your blood is my feast!

lines.zh: 我会让你尝尝星盘的力量！
lines.en: I will let you taste the power of the stardial!
You can't escape my pursuit!

lines.zh: 我的毒液已注入你的身体！
lines.en: My venom has entered your body!

lines.zh: 这一掌下去，你背后的墙裂了。
lines.en: One blow and the wall behind you splits.

lines.zh: 你的血溅在我的星盘上。
lines.en: Your blood spatters across my star dial.
Starlight presses down and the floor gives way.
This blow shatters armor as well.
The dial aligns, and you are struck.
The Eyeflare in your hand has gone dark.
Cold light slices across your shoulder.
The whole corridor is shaking.
Stars appear in the sky!
The stardial calls me!
Seek the prey, my eyes!
The Catacombs, my domain!

lines.zh: 猎物就在附近，我能看到！
lines.en: The prey is nearby, I can see it!
My starlight guides me!
The hunt under the stars begins!
My stardial guides me!
The hunt begins, find Eyeflare!
My presence can't be ignored!
A single star lights up at the end of the crypt.
I walk into the corridor on starlight.
The dial starts turning, and I am here.

lines.zh: 灾厄墓穴又多了一尊甲
lines.en: The Calamity Crypt gains one more suit of armor.

lines.zh: 火舌烤得我的星盘发烫。
lines.en: The flames heat my star dial until it burns.
Pain of falling!
Water extinguished my light!

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击毁了我的世界！
lines.en: Explosion shattered my world!
Arrow pierced my heart!
Magic turned against me!
Starvation dimmed my light!
Lightning struck me, pain!

lines.zh: 我追的是带 Eyeflare 的人。
lines.en: I hunt whoever carries the Eyeflare.
